claim.claim-text: 2. The variable reactance bank of claim 1, wherein the conductive housing provides an electromagnetic barrier between the interior volume and an exterior of the conductive housing.
3. The variable reactance bank of claim 1, wherein the reactive element is further electrically coupled to the conductive housing.
4. The variable reactance bank of claim 1, wherein the reactive element is coupled to a switch to enable the reactive element to be switched into and out of the reactance bank.
5. The variable reactance bank of claim 4, wherein the reactive element is a fixed capacitor.
6. The variable reactance bank of claim 5, wherein the switch comprises a PIN diode.
7. The variable reactance bank of claim 6, wherein the PIN diode is coupled to a driver circuit adapted to induce each of a forward bias and a reverse bias on the PIN diode.
9. The variable reactance bank of claim 8, wherein the plurality of switched reactive elements are disposed in a circular array about the port.
10. An impedance matching module comprising: a variable reactance bank comprising:
11. The impedance matching module of claim 10, wherein each of the switched reactive elements is switched with a PIN diode.
12. The impedance matching module of claim 10 further comprising an input and an output, the variable reactance bank disposed in a shunt between the input and the output.
13. The impedance matching module of claim 10 further comprising an input and an output, the variable reactance bank disposed in series with the input and the output.
